{
  "name": "pager",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Plays a sound when Claude finishes, needs you or hits an error.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/pager",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/pager#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "alerts",
    "sound",
    "notifications",
    "ntfy",
    "mute",
    "quiet-hours"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "minDuration": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum turn length (seconds)",
      "description": "Skip the done sound for turns shorter than this. Errors and needs-you always page.",
      "default": 20,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600
    },
    "quietHours": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quiet hours",
      "description": "No sound or phone push in this local time window, e.g. 22:00-07:00 (it may wrap midnight). Empty means off.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "ntfyTopic": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ntfy.sh topic (optional)",
      "description": "Also send each alert to https://ntfy.sh/<topic> as one HTTPS POST with a fixed title and short text, never conversation content. Empty means off.",
      "sensitive": true
    }
  }
}
